hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
If condition flag v is up this frame, then
  Let ability be a smart-weighted move of part.
  Part uses ability immediately and stop.
If the value "hp" of part is at most the numeric entry "hp_value_to_appear_gilgamesh" in the battle settings of the enemy, then choose state 22 next and stop.
Let bpConfsIndex be the register's 'bpConfsIndex'.
Let v2 be call helper3 with (this state, 1).
If bpConfsIndex is not v2, then
  Call helper2 with (this state, 1, v2).
  Part cancels its cast and stop.
If part is ready to act, then part picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
